The test reports shall be submitted to the EIC i.e HOD(O &M) through email (hodom.nmhps@sjvn.nic.in) for verification and obtaining dispatch cl earance. The material shall be dispatched only after receipt of clearance. 2.8 For MII purchase preference If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must mention make and upload certificate from the OEM regarding the percentage of the local content a nd the details of locations at which the local value addition is made along with their bid, failing which no purchase preference shall be granted. 2.9 Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) / Bid Security · Submission of EMD through Online Payment Bidders may submit the Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) through online payment viaR TGS / NEFT / Internet Banking in favour of SJVN Limited, as per the details give n below: Particulars Details Beneficiary Name SJVN Limited

A scanned copy/proof of successful online payment of EMD shall be uploaded along with the bid. Caution: Bidders shall ensure that the correct beneficiary account number and IFSC code are used while making the payment. In case of remittance to an incorrect account, SJVN Limited, its Bank, or service provider shall not be responsible for the same. · Submission of EMD in the form of FDR / TDR Alternatively, the bidder may submit the Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) / Term Deposit Receipt (TDR) issued by a Nation alized Bank or any Scheduled Bank, as per RBI guidelines, duly pledged in favour of SJVN Limited. A scanned copy of the FDR/TDR shall be uploaded along with the bid. · EMD / Bid Security Exemption Bidders seeking exemption from submission of Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) / Bid S ecurity shall submit valid supporting documents for the relevant category, as per Ge M General Terms and Conditions (GTC), along with the bid. · Under the MSE category, only manufacturers (for goods) and service provi ders (for services) shall be eligible for EMD exemption. · Traders are not eligible for exemption under this policy. HOD (P&C) Yamuna Parisar, NMHPS SJVN Limited Village – Bainol Tehsil – Mori District – Uttarkashi Uttarakhand – 249128 Remarks: Earnest Money Deposit submitted in the form of Demand Draft (DD), local cheque , or outstation cheque shall not be accepted. 2.10 MANDATORY REGISTRATION ON TReDS PORTAL FOR MSME VENDORS TReDS (Trade Receivables Discounting System) is an electronic platform for facilitating the financing/discounting of trade receivables of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) through multiple financiers. It addresses the issue of delayed payments to MSMEs. Such rec eivables may be due from corporates and other buyers, including Government Department s and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). It is mandatory for all Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) to register themselves on T ReDS and facilitate/ensure the onboarding of MSE vendors on the TReDS platform. The following three TReDS platforms are presently operational in India: 1. Receivables Exchange of India Ltd. (RXIL); 2. M1xchange; and 3. Invoicemart. SJVN Limited is presently transacting through M1xchange and Invoicemart TReDS platfo rms only. MSE vendors may avail the facility by registering themselves with any of the exch anges providing e-discounting/electronic factoring services through the TReDS platform an d by following the procedures prescribed therein. Accordingly, all MSE vendors are hereby advised, in their own interest, to register themselv es on the TReDS portal. The contract shall be awarded to an eligible MSE bidder only after the bidder has complete d registration on the TReDS portal. The MSE bidder shall submit the TReDS registration deta ils along with its bid. Alternatively, the MSE bidder may submit, along with its bid, an undertaking on its letterhe ad stating as under: “It is confirmed that our firm shall get registered on the TReDS portal, if found L- 1, before placement of the order.” The successful MSE bidder shall ensure registration on the TReDS portal and submit docum entary evidence of such registration before award of the contract. In case the successful MSE bidder fails to complete the TReDS registration and submit the requisite doc umentary evidence, the contract shall not be awarded. 2.11 Bid Submission

Any other statutory deductions, such as TDS, etc., as applicable under the contract and p revailing Government laws, shall be deducted from the payment due to the contractor. Accordingly, the bidder shall quote the applicable taxes and duties in the bid. B. Techno-Commercial Bid Part The Techno-Commercial Bid shall consist of the following: i. Copy of GST Registration Certificate/Number, as applicable under the GST Act. ii. Copy of PAN Card/PAN Number and copy of cancelled cheque. iii. Copy of EMD submission, as applicable. iv. Certification of Local Content as per Make in India (MII) Purchase Preference, wherever applicable. v. TReDS Registration details or undertaking, applicable only to MSE vendors. vi.
